title: Miaomiao integration to improve
body:
Hi, 
Let me explain the situation and the flow of events leading me here to mention an issue. 

I'm using xdrip since 14 days in closed loop with cgm libre+ miaomiao, Android aps and dana RS pump. 

My miaomiao ran out of battery. 
But I kept receiving wrong data in xdrip. 
Screenshot 1: 
![Screenshot_20190718-233522_xDrip+](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19931278/61493819-cd97dd00-a9b4-11e9-9fb8-ebfe5a143443.jpg)

Data add always same value which was a wrong and misleading input.. 

This behaviour happened when starting to sleep around 11pm.. (so could have been dangerous as wrong data to start the night) 

Night was ok, and I thought it was great as still getting very linear results... 

Only I few hours later, I understood that miaomiao was out of battery. 
But I got it by myself... I was still receiving wrong data, and displayed tomato battery level was 50%.. 

So a better management for miaomiao's battery input would be great. And also that this behavior (sending wrong data when ending battry) doesn't happen, as it's really misleading. 

I broke my freestyle trying to get value by nfc from xdrip. Everything was back to normal with new cgm and miao refilled, but things could have really gone sideways, so improvement for miaomiao integration/support in xdrip would be great. 
(Battery level detection improved, alarm for it..) 
Thanks, keep making the world better :)
